tools.description: Get complete assembled metadata including all contracts, composition rules, and token relationships.

tools.description: Get index health: status, component count, pattern count, warnings, gaps.

tools.description: Get component summary: identity, contract categories, token count, annotations. ~200 tokens.

tools.description: Get design do's and don'ts as categorized directives. Optionally filter by category.

tools.description: Discover docs by concept/keyword (concept mode, ranked), or enumerate the full catalog (list mode, paginated). Supersedes get_documentation_map.
tools.name: find_docs

tools.description: Get complete document content with metadata. Use when summaries are insufficient and full content is needed.
tools.name: get_document_full

tools.description: Get document summary with metadata and outline. Returns ~200 tokens to enable informed decisions about loading full content.
tools.name: get_document_summary

tools.description: Get the health status of the document index. Returns status (healthy/degraded/failed), errors, warnings, and metrics including document count, section count, cross-reference count, and index size.
tools.name: get_index_health

tools.description: Get specific document section by heading. Returns section content with parent context, a stable sectionId, and siblingHeadings (adjacent sections under the same parent — a cue that more may exist). For a heading that occurs more than once, pass "parent" or "sectionId" to disambiguate; otherwise the response lists the candidate occurrences. RULE: when retrieving a multi-section logical unit, call get_document_summary first (summary-first) so sibling sections are discoverable rather than silently omitted.
tools.name: get_section

tools.description: List cross-references in a document. Returns all referenced documents with context, source section, and line number.
tools.name: list_cross_references

tools.description: Rebuild the documentation index from scratch. Use this when the index is corrupted or out of sync. Returns the new index health status after rebuild.
tools.name: rebuild_index

tools.description: Validate document metadata schema. Checks for required fields (Date, Purpose, Organization, Scope, Layer, Relevant Tasks) and returns specific error messages for each issue.
tools.name: validate_metadata

tools.description: Find design principles by keyword.
tools.name: find_principles

tools.description: Get domain object definition and list of screens that reference it.
